entities.name: PMID:25077631
observations: In human THP-1 monocytes, MALP-2-induced HO-1 expression was almost completely blocked by dominant-negative Mal or Mal siRNA; MyD88 inhibition was insufficient. PI3K involvement was supported by LY294002 inhibition. DOI:10.1371/journal.pone.0103433.

entities.name: MALP-2
observations: A TLR2/6 ligand; in THP-1 monocytes it induces HO-1 through a pathway dependent on Mal and involving PI3K, according to PMID:25077631.

entities.name: TIRAP (Mal)
observations: Dominant-negative Mal and Mal siRNA almost completely blocked MALP-2-induced HO-1 in THP-1 monocytes in PMID:25077631.

entities.name: PI3K signaling
observations: PI3K involvement in MALP-2-induced HO-1 in THP-1 monocytes was supported by inhibition with LY294002 in PMID:25077631.

entities.name: HMOX1 (HO-1)
observations: MALP-2 induces HO-1 in human THP-1 monocytes; Mal disruption nearly abolishes induction and PI3K inhibition attenuates it in PMID:25077631.
